liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Just Like Tom Thumb's Blues** (3 reviews): The reviewer considers this performance the low point of the show due to Phil's singing; The reviewer prefers this version for its deeper pocket and solid vocal performance [31][33][37]
- **Cold Rain & Snow** (1 review): The opener was described as out of this world by the attendee [29]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): The transition from Bird Song into Comes a Time was memorable for attendees [32]
- **Deal** (1 review): The reviewer notes the song was smokin and essential for the show's completeness [36]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): The reviewer feels a tingle and buzz when listening to this specific song [38]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-06-28.151254.sbd.eaton.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 146 min [1]
- **gd1985-06-28.154538.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 144 min [2]
- **gd1985-06-28.151829.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.miller.clugston.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 143 min [4]
- **gd1985-06-28.111343.BeyerM160.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 140 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd85-06-28.sbd.lemon2.5822.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 135 min; rated 4.29/5 by 78 [15]. Said about its sound: The bass on this recording gets very low but remains clean and clear in the mix; The reviewer finds Jerry's voice shot and playing sluggish during this specific performance; The recording features watery wah effects, aggressive rock chords, and sturdy drums [31][35][40]

## Around the show

- Rain persisted most of the day before the outdoor performance at Hershey Park Stadium [29]
- Bobby referenced the crack equipment crews and singing in the rain before the next song [29]
- Phil blew a speaker during Morning Dew, an issue also present at Merriweather [31]
- Jerry wore a blue corduroy blazer during this small venue performance with sweet summer rain [32]
- Phil actually popped the speakers during the Morning Dew performance [32]
- The show featured rain and mud, creating a fun summer atmosphere for the audience [36]
- Attendees arrived during cold rain and snow after driving from Saratoga the night before [39]
- Phil fried some speakers during Morning Dew, confirmed by nearby audience members [39]
- The show is viewed as an example of Jerry's low points during his darkest days [35]
- Fans would play this show in the car after seeing live shows in the early 90s [38]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-06-28.151254.sbd.eaton.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Thanks to Rob Eaton for the 1st generation cassettes > DAT (16/48) transfer and Tim Dalton for the source DAT (16/48); transferred by Thanks to Charlie Miller for Tim Dalton's DAT transfer and coordinating this effort. Mastered by Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony D5M)> 1st generation cassettes (Sony D5M) > Rob Eaton's DAT (Panasonic SV-3800)(16/48) > Tim Dalton's DAT (Panasonic… [1]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplies patches in Deal and Drums from the Oade's [1]
- **gd1985-06-28.154538.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M [2]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplies patches in Deal and Drums from the Oade's [2]
- **gd1985-06-28.151829.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.miller.clugston.flac16**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Doug Oade & Scott Clugston; source: 1st Set and Morning Dew thru Encore: Oade brothers Master Audience Cassettes ; Schoeps CMC4 MK41 mics > Sony D5M 2nd Set thru I Need A Miracle: Oade brothers… [4]
- **gd1985-06-28.111343.BeyerM160.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: flac16: Recorded by The Weasel - "Da Weez" Transferred and mastered to .wav files by D5scott Source: 2 Beyer M160 microphones > Sony TC-D5M - analog master… [5]. Also: The mic stand was dead center, right over the stage, for the first set [5]
- **gd85-06-28.sbd.lemon2.5822.sbeok.shnf**: source: Liberated Bootleg [15]
